```{r setup}
project_root <- rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)
setwd(project_root)

# To add a new package: renv::install("packageName") or renv::install("bioc::packageName"), then renv::snapshot(). Snapshots are always run in the console

pacman::p_load(Seurat, data.table, tidyverse, Matrix)

# Fig. 6C: adult N. viridescens limb blastema at 18 dpa, Smart-seq2 (Subramanian et al. 2023, PRJNA904299), downloaded with
# notophthalmus_sc_download.sh and quantified with kallisto against the Katia transcriptome of the A1 bulk data
# (notophthalmus_sc_quant.sh). Processed as in the paper: one gene per symbol, ERCC QC, and the Kiloscript / Hectoscript
# split by detected genes. The saved object is read by figure6/figure6.Rmd
data_dir <- "in_vivo_newt_regeneration/data/notophthalmus_sc"
res_dir  <- "in_vivo_newt_regeneration/results/notophthalmus_sc"
```


# Preparing Data

```{r counts}
# kb count gene matrix: cells in rows, Katia GENEIDs in columns, turned to genes x cells
counts <- readMM(file.path(data_dir, "matrix.abundance.gene.mtx")) %>%
  t() %>%
  as("CsparseMatrix")

rownames(counts) <- readLines(file.path(data_dir, "genes.txt"))
colnames(counts) <- readLines(file.path(data_dir, "matrix.cells"))

# Katia annotation, one row per GENEID (the isoform with the most GO terms), same as A1_diff_dediff.Rmd
annotations <- read.csv("Nvir_Annotations/Nvir Latest Annotation Katia/Nvir_annotations_MT_Katia_final.csv", header = TRUE)

annotations$X.GO_IP[is.na(annotations$X.GO_IP)] <- 0

setDT(annotations)
annotations_gid <- annotations[, .SD[which.max(X.GO_IP)], by = GENEID]

# One gene per symbol, as in the paper: numbered copies and case variants of a symbol (HIF3A, HIF3A.1, Hif3a) are
# summed, unannotated GENEIDs (SYMBOL = g.*) are dropped
annotations_gid <- annotations_gid %>%
  mutate(gene = ifelse(grepl("^g\\.", SYMBOL), NA, toupper(sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", SYMBOL))))

gene <- annotations_gid$gene[match(rownames(counts), annotations_gid$GENEID)]

# fac2sparse() makes a 0/1 genes x GENEIDs matrix, so the product sums the GENEIDs of each gene
counts <- fac2sparse(factor(gene[!is.na(gene)])) %*% counts[!is.na(gene), ]

seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = round(counts), project = "blastema_18dpa") # kallisto counts are estimates

dim(seu) # 15,619 genes, 766 cells (2 of the 768 runs are corrupted on ENA)
```

```{r qc}
# Paper QC on ERCC spike-ins, no gene-number filter. The paper kept cells with > 10 detected ERCCs after STAR (739 of 768:
# 376 Hecto, 363 Kilo). kallisto's exact k-mer matching detects fewer spike-ins per cell, and > 5 removes the same failed
# wells (median 4 ERCC reads) and keeps nearly as many cells (742: 379 Hecto, 363 Kilo); > 10 would also drop 61 Hectoscripts
# and 10 Kiloscripts
ercc <- readMM(file.path(data_dir, "ercc.mtx")) # cells x ERCCs
n_ercc <- setNames(rowSums(ercc > 0), readLines(file.path(data_dir, "ercc.cells")))

seu$ercc_detected <- replace_na(unname(n_ercc[colnames(seu)]), 0) # 0 for cells without any ERCC read

seu <- subset(seu, subset = ercc_detected > 5)

ncol(seu) # 742 cells
```

```{r populations}
# Detected genes are bimodal: Kiloscripts (paper ~4,600 genes) and Hectoscripts (~540 genes, MKNK2-high), split at the trough
genes_histogram <- ggplot(seu@meta.data, aes(nFeature_RNA)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1500, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "Detected genes per cell", y = "Cells") +
  theme_minimal()

genes_histogram

ggsave(filename = file.path(res_dir, "detected_genes.png"), plot = genes_histogram, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 600, bg = "white")

seu$population <- ifelse(seu$nFeature_RNA > 1500, "Kiloscript", "Hectoscript")

table(seu$population) # 379 Hectoscripts, 363 Kiloscripts
```

```{r clustering}
# Log-normalised, 2,000 variable genes, 15 PCs, resolution 0.5
seu <- NormalizeData(seu)

seu <- FindVariableFeatures(seu, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

seu <- ScaleData(seu)

seu <- RunPCA(seu, features = VariableFeatures(seu))

seu <- FindNeighbors(seu, dims = 1:15)
seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = 0.5)
seu <- RunUMAP(seu, dims = 1:15)
```


# Cell types

```{r markers}
# Marker genes per cluster, behind the cell types below. Myf5 / Myog / Myod1 are not in the Katia reference, Pax7 has no reads
cell_markers <- list(
  muscle      = c("DES", "ACTA1", "TNNT1", "MYH2", "PAX7"),
  mesenchyme  = c("PRRX1", "COL1A1", "TWIST1", "LUM"),
  epidermis   = c("KRT5", "KRT17", "EPCAM"),
  immune      = c("PTPRC", "CD74"),
  endothelial = c("PECAM1", "KDR"),
  blood       = c("HBA1", "HBB1"),
  cycling     = c("MKI67", "TOP2A"),
  hectoscript = c("MKNK2")
)

marker_dotplot <- DotPlot(seu, features = lapply(cell_markers, function(genes) intersect(genes, rownames(seu))), cluster.idents = TRUE) +
  RotatedAxis() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9))

marker_dotplot

ggsave(filename = file.path(res_dir, "cell_type_markers.png"), plot = marker_dotplot, width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 600, bg = "white")

# Cells, median detected genes and Hectoscript share per cluster
seu@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(cells = n(), genes = median(nFeature_RNA), hectoscript = round(mean(population == "Hectoscript"), 2))
```

```{r cell-types}
# Fig. 6C: cell type per cluster, from the dot plot, the table above and the top genes per cluster (FindAllMarkers, run
# outside this notebook)
cell_types <- c("0" = "Hectoscript", "1" = "mesenchyme", "2" = "epidermis", "3" = "mesenchyme IL11+",
                "4" = "macrophages", "5" = "chondrogenic", "6" = "erythrocytes")

seu$cell_type <- unname(cell_types[as.character(seu$seurat_clusters)])

umap_cell_types <- DimPlot(seu, group.by = "cell_type")

umap_cell_types

ggsave(filename = file.path(res_dir, "umap_cell_types.png"), plot = umap_cell_types, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```


# Save

```{r save}
# Fig. 6C: figure6/figure6.Rmd keeps the RNA data of the Fig. 6 genes and the population and cell_type columns
saveRDS(seu, file.path(data_dir, "blastema_18dpa.rds"))
```
